reviewItem.question: Does "api: roll back run function protobuf extra resources field name change by @jbw976 in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6682" mean a change to protocol-behavior:crossplane|name=run-function-extra-resources-field-name (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: In Crossplane v2.0.0 the earlier change to the run function protobuf's extra resources field name was rolled back, so the extra resources field in the RunFunction protobuf keeps its prior name.
